description: This Java class 'HttpUtils' provides utility methods for extracting headers, cookies, and authorization information from HTTP requests within the Eclipse Ditto project, specifically for security-related processing.

classes.name: HttpUtils
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for handling HTTP headers, cookies, and authorization in request contexts.

methods.name: getRequestHeader
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a specified header from the request context, returning an Optional.

methods.name: getHeaders
methods.description: Extracts all headers and cookies from the request context into a RequestHeaders object.

methods.name: containsAuthorizationForPrefix
methods.description: Checks if the request contains an authorization header starting with a specific prefix.

methods.name: basicAuthUsernameMatches
methods.description: Verifies if the username in the Basic HTTP Authorization header matches a given UUID pattern.
